description: Compute a deadline from a start date and a period in calendar days, working days, Gregorian months or Hijri months, applying the counting rules YOU specify (exclude start day, extend past weekends/holidays, half-day handling, estimated-holiday handling). Returns the deadline, the raw date before extension, every skipped day and a step-by-step explanation. Use when drafting contract, notice, appeal or payment deadlines in the UAE. This is date arithmetic only; it does not state what any law requires, and every response carries a disclaimer field. Example: {start_date:'2026-11-26', period:7, unit:'calendar_days', emirate:'federal', sector:'public'} → raw 2026-12-03 (National Day, estimated) → deadline 2026-12-04, data_confidence 'medium'. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

exclude_start_day.description: Day 1 is the day after start_date (true, default) or start_date itself.
exclude_start_day.title: Exclude Start Day

extend_if_ends_on_non_working_day.description: Roll a deadline that lands on a weekend/holiday forward to the next working day (default true).
extend_if_ends_on_non_working_day.title: Extend If Ends On Non Working Day

include_estimated_holidays.description: Count not-yet-announced (estimated) holidays as non-working days (default true).
include_estimated_holidays.title: Include Estimated Holidays

month_end_clamp.description: For month units: clamp 31 Jan + 1 month to 28/29 Feb (default true).
month_end_clamp.title: Month End Clamp

treat_half_day_as_working.description: Friday half days count as working days (default true).
treat_half_day_as_working.title: Treat Half Day As Working

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

period.description: Length of the period in `unit`. Negative counts backwards.
period.title: Period

rules.description: Counting conventions. Pass what the contract/rule says; defaults are the common convention.

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
sector.title: Sector

start_date.description: ISO date the period starts from (e.g. date of notification).
start_date.title: Start Date

name: compute_deadline
title: Compute a deadline with explicit counting rules
